evidence_boundary.promotion_rule: Financial or market material may be registered as a scoped research signal or indicator only after a separately versioned, reproducible, leakage-safe experiment meets its pre-registered acceptance criteria and completes independent review. Promotion does not create trading advice, a causal claim, or a guaranteed forecast.
non_claims: No untested association is a validated signal.
A statistically reported association is not proof of a causal mechanism.
A promoted research signal is not a buy, sell, hold, allocation, or execution instruction.

records.definition: Register a falsifiable research question, null hypothesis, population, unit of analysis, observation window, features, target, baseline, metric, split, decision rule, and prohibited uses before feature engineering or model selection.
records.purpose: Separate confirmatory testing from exploratory pattern search and prevent outcome-shaped research claims.

records.definition: Acquire actual observations only through documented sources with resolved rights, preserved raw artifacts, hashes, schema snapshots, retrieval timestamps, coverage metadata, and provider adjustment or revision policies.
records.purpose: Create auditable source lineage without asserting that any data has been acquired.

records.definition: Define every feature with a stable ID, semantic definition, calculation or source, data type, units, source IDs, available_at boundary, version, missing-value policy, and transformation metadata.
records.purpose: Make it possible to audit whether every model input was genuinely knowable at each decision cutoff.

records.definition: Create target labels independently of candidate feature families, beginning only after the feature cutoff plus a declared censor gap and carrying a versioned source and coding rule.
records.purpose: Prevent target leakage and tautological labels.
failure_conditions: future-revised label used without historical availability

records.definition: Evaluate time-indexed rows through expanding or rolling training windows followed by contiguous future validation windows, retaining a final chronological holdout untouched until candidate selection is complete.
records.purpose: Measure temporal generalization without training on future observations.

records.definition: Remove train rows whose target windows overlap a validation period and apply a declared temporal embargo when serial dependence, publication lag, or event overlap can transmit outcome information across folds.
records.purpose: Prevent nearby records from revealing the same outcome period.
failure_conditions: overlapping outcomes remain in train and validation

records.definition: Fit scaling, imputation, feature selection, encoding, resampling, and hyperparameter tuning exclusively on each training fold before application to its corresponding validation fold.
records.purpose: Prevent validation or final-holdout information from influencing model preparation.
failure_conditions: imputer or scaler fit on validation rows

records.definition: Compare any candidate against a predeclared naive market or buy-and-hold baseline, a seasonal or regime baseline when applicable, and a feature-ablated comparator when astrology or sentiment features are included.
records.purpose: Distinguish a candidate from simpler non-astrological explanations.
failure_conditions: baseline evaluated on a different fold structure

records.definition: Report sample size, exclusions, class balance or target distribution, missingness, fold dispersion, confidence or bootstrap intervals, regime sensitivity, provider drift, and negative or null outcomes.
records.purpose: Prevent selective reporting and unstable-claim inflation.
required_controls: fold-level rather than only aggregate reporting
failure_conditions: favorable folds selected without full log
regime claim lacks definition or sample count

records.definition: Audit data vintages, delayed publication, restatements, corporate-action adjustments, historical universe membership, delistings, suspensions, and exclusions before interpreting a temporal result.
records.purpose: Expose temporal and sample-selection bias that a feature cutoff alone cannot prevent.
failure_conditions: present-day universe treated as historical population
revised values treated as historically available

records.definition: Permit a methodology-bound financial or market record to become a scoped research-exploratory signal or indicator only after reproducible pre-registration, resolved rights, leakage-safe walk-forward evidence, a final holdout, uncertainty reporting, and independent review.
records.purpose: Prevent untested materials from being presented as signals or indicators.
failure_conditions: source prose alone offered as validation

records.definition: Treat news, recommendations, holders, and other sentiment proxies as timestamped features with source, availability, revision, rights, and missingness metadata rather than as direct market instructions.
records.purpose: Maintain source-specific timing and license controls for non-price feature families.
failure_conditions: sentiment proxy lacks historical availability metadata
